description: Search procurement projects on simap.ch (Confederation, cantons, municipalities, public companies). Filter by text, cantons of performance, project type, latest notice type (e.g. 'tender' = open calls, 'award_tender' = awarded contracts) and publication date. Needs `query` (3+ chars) or at least one filter. Results are newest first; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. Example: {query: 'Schulhaus', cantons: ['ZH'], notice_types: ['tender']}.

cantons.description: Cantons where the contract is performed, e.g. ['ZH','AG']

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (`next_cursor` from the previous page)

lang.description: Language for titles and texts (falls back to the notice's original language)

notice_types.description: Type of the newest notice: tender (open call), award_tender (award), direct_award, advance_notice, revocation, …

name: search_public_tenders
title: Search Swiss public tenders & awards
